title: A Convergence Analysis of the Random Feature Method for Linear PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2611.20951v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Random Feature Method (RFM) distinguishes itself among machine learning approaches to partial differential equations (PDEs) through its superior accuracy and computational efficiency. Nevertheless, the theoretical underpinnings of RFM remain incompletely elucidated. This paper provides a comprehensive analysis of RFM within the framework of kernel methods, focusing on two principal aspects: (i) approximation by finitely many random features in Sobolev norms and the PDE residual seminorm, and (ii) estimation over the induced reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) from finitely many noiseless collocation observations. We relate both problems to kernel ridge regression (KRR) and establish upper and lower bounds in terms of the eigenvalues of the associated integral operators under the respective assumptions. translated_title: 线性偏微分方程随机特征方法的收敛性分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.20951v1 公告类型： cross 摘要：随机特征方法（RFM）凭借其卓越的精度和计算效率，在求解偏微分方程（PDE）的机器学习方法中脱颖而出。然而，RFM的理论基础尚未得到完全阐明。本文在核方法框架下对RFM进行了全面分析，重点关注两个主要方面：（i）利用有限个随机特征在Sobolev范数和PDE残差半范数意义下的逼近；（ii）基于有限个无噪声配置点观测，在诱导出的再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）上进行估计。我们将这两个问题与核岭回归（KRR）联系起来，并在相应假设下依据相关积分算子的特征值建立了上下界。结合逼近下界与估计下界，我们在随机特征数量与配置点数量同时受限的条件下建立了一个下界。
tldr: 本文在核方法框架下对随机特征方法求解线性偏微分方程建立了系统的收敛性理论，将有限随机特征逼近与RKHS估计问题归结为核岭回归，并基于积分算子特征值给出了误差的上下界。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a systematic convergence theory for the Random Feature Method for linear PDEs within the kernel methods framework, recasting finite random feature approximation and RKHS estimation as kernel ridge regression and deriving upper and lower bounds in terms of integral operator eigenvalues.
